opus.problem: The setting (a great crowd gathered in Jerusalem for the Feast of Unleavened Bread) comes from 2 Chronicles 30:13, not the cited verse 30:14. The cited BSB verse only says they removed the altars and incense altars and threw them into the Kidron Valley. The reference should be 2 Chronicles 30:13-14 so the clue is true to its cited text.
